personality_one_liner: Clean, highly readable iOS-native structure tailored for a dual-sided Arabic marketplace: bright, trustworthy light theme for customers, and a premium dark-utility theme for merchants.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Avoid dense dashboard styles. Thumb zone primary CTA sticky at bottom.

do's: Sticky header backgrounds over scrolling content

screens.name: Customer - Service Detail
screens.purpose: Showcase service offerings, warranty, pricing, and social proof to drive booking.

states.loading: Skeleton of hero image and tabs
states.error: Failed to load service details, with retry button

screens.layout: RTL Native. Edge-to-edge hero image with top-to-bottom gradient scrim. Glass header over image. Sticky bottom sheet/container with 'Book Now' primary CTA. Tabs below hero for About / Experiences / Reviews. Use horizontal scrolling for customer experience video thumbnails.

screens.name: Customer - Booking Sheet
screens.purpose: Capture booking details, calculate dynamic pickup fee, and confirm schedule.
screens.layout: Full-height bottom sheet. Segmented control for Drop-off vs Pickup/Return. Map view snippet for location. Dynamic fee calculation prominently displayed in LTR numeric format. Grid layout for time slots.

screens.name: Customer - My Services (Progress)
screens.purpose: Track live status of device repair and view/rate merchant video updates.
screens.layout: Vertical step progress tracker (Pending -> Completed). Below tracker, a chronological feed of video update cards. Each card has an embedded video player (expo-av) and a 5-star rating input with comment box.

screens.name: Customer - Experiences Gallery
screens.purpose: Public social proof feed of successful repairs.
screens.layout: Vertical scrollable feed of videos (similar to TikTok/Reels) with overlay text. Shows customer rating and merchant caption. Gradient scrim behind text.

screens.name: Merchant - Service Form
screens.purpose: Create or edit a service listing with comprehensive details.
screens.layout: Dark theme. Single column scrollable form. Multi-image picker at top. Toggle switches for pickup support and availability. Sticky 'Save Service' CTA at bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Merchant - Video Update Composer
screens.purpose: Record and upload short video updates to customers with optional social cross-posting.
screens.layout: Dark theme. Camera view taking up top 60%. Caption input below. Toggles for 'Make Public Experience' and 'Cross-post to Social Feed' below caption. Big primary upload button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Data Models: Add MongoDB collections: 'services_extension', 'service_bookings', 'service_updates' (videos), 'service_reviews'. Ensure 'service_updates' supports flags for 'is_public_experience' and 'is_crossposted'.

API Endpoints: Create/modify POST /api/services, GET /api/services/{id}, POST /api/bookings (calc dynamic fee based on geo), POST /api/service_updates (handle Emergent Object Storage URL + in-app notification trigger).

Theme Handling: Explicitly use the light theme token set (#8833FF brand) for all Customer screens and the dark theme token set (#0A0A0A bg, #F5C518 brand) for all Merchant screens. These must not leak into each other.
RTL/LTR: App must use RTL layout for all text and containers. LTR is ONLY used for numeric values, pricing, and timers.
Component - Video Player: Use expo-av for video playback. Implement gradient scrims (transparent to ≥70% surfaceInverse) whenever text is overlaid on video or hero images.
Notifications: DO NOT design OS-level push notifications infrastructure. Use an in-app notification bell + real-time badge in the tab bar for video update alerts.
Interaction: Ensure the 'Book Now' and 'Save Service' buttons are sticky at the bottom with a glass effect behind them to ensure thumb-reachability without scroll.

MVP Scope: Focus on service creation, basic booking with manual fee entry if dynamic mapping is too complex for phase 1, and the video update upload + rating flow. Cross-posting to social feed can be Phase 2 if Emergent Object Storage integration is tight.
